name: Almadev Real Estate Inc.
summary: Almadev Real Estate Inc. owns and operates real estate properties in Canada. The company identifies, acquires, and upgrades properties. Its properties include multi-residential rental properties, senior housing complexes, commercial retail shopping centers, offices and residential buildings. The company also develops condominiums. The company was formerly known as EL-AD Group (Canada) Inc. Almadev Real Estate Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Almadev Real Estate Inc. is a subsidiary of Almadev Holdings LP.
